terra.problem: The place is labeled a city, but Luke 24:13 calls Emmaus a village.
The line suggests the disciples walked and talked with Jesus in Emmaus. In the cited verses, they were on their way to the village.
All three moments happen on the way to Emmaus, not at Emmaus itself.
The title “Two travelers leave Jerusalem” states a departure that Luke 24:13–14 does not explicitly describe.
